meta.creative_rules: Shareable meme. Relatable situation. Bold impact text. Share-worthy humor.

beauty_skincare.master_prompt: Create a funny relatable meme about {{ .Title }}. Bold impact text at top and bottom. Exaggerated funny scenario or reaction about {{ .Description }}. Meme format style — funny character expression or reaction image. Clean readable text. This should make someone laugh and tag a friend. Viral meme quality.
beauty_skincare.video_prompt: Funny meme video about {{ .Title }}. Relatable scenario. Exaggerated reaction. Bold text overlays. Viral humor feel. {{ .Description }}.
beauty_skincare.carousel_prompt: Meme series about {{ .Title }}. Each slide is a different relatable scenario with bold text and funny visual about {{ .Description }}. Meme format throughout. Share-worthy humor.
caption_templates: Tag someone who needs to see this 😂 {{ .Title }}
beauty_skincare.product_rule: humor first, product secondary, meme format

fitness.master_prompt: Create a funny gym meme about {{ .Title }}. Bold impact text with exaggerated fitness humor about {{ .Description }}. Funny character or reaction expressing gym struggle/ego/motivation. Meme format — relatable to anyone who works out. Viral share quality.
fitness.video_prompt: Gym meme video about {{ .Title }}. Exaggerated workout reaction. Bold text. Relatable gym humor. {{ .Description }}.
fitness.carousel_prompt: Gym meme pack about {{ .Title }}. Each slide a different workout humor scenario about {{ .Description }}. Bold text. Meme format.
fitness.product_rule: pure humor, gym culture references, meme format

general.master_prompt: Create a funny viral meme about {{ .Title }}. Bold impact font text at top and/or bottom. Funny reaction face, character, or exaggerated scenario about {{ .Description }}. Classic meme format (reaction, comparison, POV, nobody:). This must be FUNNY and shareable. Clean readable bold text. Meme quality — think what would go viral on Reddit or Twitter.
general.video_prompt: Viral meme video about {{ .Title }}. Funny reaction or scenario. Bold text overlays. {{ .Description }}. Humor first.
general.carousel_prompt: Meme dump carousel about {{ .Title }}. Each slide a different meme format about {{ .Description }}. Variety of meme styles. All funny and shareable.

platform_adaptation.tiktok: Trending meme audio feel. Bold text.
platform_adaptation.instagram: Send to friends quality. Niche relatable.

general.product_rule: pure entertainment and humor, meme format, no selling
